theorems.name: Submission.lpf_raf_chart_change_of_variables
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → A ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEMeasurable g ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → NullMeasurableSet (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A) (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) ∧ AEMeasurable (fun w => g (Φ w)) ((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in A, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ w in Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' A, g (Φ w) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
